Customer messaging: contacts, companies, conversations, tickets and help center articles.

## API key

1. Open [app.intercom.com](https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/_/developer-hub) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** The Access Token of a private app in your workspace's Developer Hub.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add intercom
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  intercom: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Intercom's [API](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/build-an-integration/learn-more/rest-apis) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show intercom` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 10000 a minute. Per workspace, shared by its private apps; 25,000 a minute across all apps; counted in 10-second windows.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Intercom).
